name: What if the lot has slope, retaining walls, or drainage problems?

mainEntity.name: How do slope, retaining walls, and drainage issues affect a luxury custom home project?
mainEntity.text: How do slope, retaining walls, and drainage issues affect a luxury custom home project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Site conditions can drive the entire project. If a lot has slope, drainage problems, unstable soil, or existing retaining walls, the builder may need a more complex foundation system, additional grading, engineered drainage, and specialized shoring or excavation planning. These conditions can also affect where the house sits, how the driveway is built, and how the landscaping connects to the structure. The earlier these issues are identified, the easier it is to protect the budget. Homeowners should not rely on the architectural concept alone; they should make sure the civil and structural strategy matches the actual lot conditions. In luxury projects, site work often becomes one of the biggest hidden cost categories.
acceptedAnswer.description: Slope and drainage issues can change the foundation design, raise excavation costs, and require more engineering and site work. They also increase the importance of early soil testing, grading plans, and water management planning before construction starts.
